title: Void Jester
personality:
Malgrave's court jester. He laughed the night the Hunters were sealed, so Malgrave sealed him in a toy box and threw it into the Void. He came back as a jack-in-the-box: a jester on a brass spring, rising from a hovering box.
He steals his victims' laughter, his bells ring only when he swaps, and he belongs to no one.
fantasy: The Void Jester who never touches the ground. Pulls the fight to him, then lets it fall in.
silhouette: a floating jester in a three-tailed cap, his smoky tail trailing below

card.role: Controller: stuns from range, drops a growing bomb on the stunned, and trades places to set it up.
card.loop: Controller: stuns from range, drops a growing bomb on the stunned, and trades places to set it up.
card.lmb: Tether Lantern: quick orbs to full range through walls; the longer you wait between shots, the bigger and harder the next one, and a full orb slows.
card.rmb: Shard Snap: a short wind-up, then a bundle of shards that stuns the first foe, longer the further it flew.
card.e: Brimseed: drop a bomb at the cursor that grows for {e.grow}s; press again to pop it, harder the bigger it grew.
card.dash: Lantern Trade: lob a lantern to the cursor and hover where you are; when it lands, everyone in its circle goes to your spot and you go to theirs.
card.passive: Swell: your hits fill Swell (much faster on hunters); full, you are Swollen for {resource.swollen_t}s and everything grows. You float, so ground hazards pass you by.

weapons.tether_lantern: Quick orbs to full range through walls; the longer you wait between shots (up to {lmb.idle}s) the bigger, faster and harder the next one, and a full orb slows.

card.x: Nightwell: from level 6, open a well at the cursor that stuns everything inside for {x.time}s and draws it to the middle.

passive.name: Swell
passive.desc: Damage you deal fills Swell (ten times as fast against hunters). Full Swell makes you Swollen for {resource.swollen_t}s, wrapped in a pink sphere: your seed grows larger and faster, Trade lands sooner, your Snap hits {rmb.snap.swollen_k%}% harder. You float: lava, spore pods and other ground hazards pass you by.

dash.name: Lantern Trade
dash.desc: Hold Shift to see both ends, let go (or tap) to lob a lantern to the cursor, up to {dash.reach}m (past that, at {dash.reach}m toward it), over ground, walls or the abyss. You hover at your height until it lands, even over the abyss, drifting at {dash.fly_slow%}% speed, with a sigil marking each end. {dash.time}s later you are there, keeping your height, and everyone in its {dash.radius}m circle (foes, allies and Boki) is sent to where you are when it lands, each keeping its place in the circle. Swollen: {dash.time_swollen}s.

variants.tap: A {rmb.snap.wind}s wind-up, then one tight bundle of shards to {rmb.snap.range}m. It stuns the first foe it hits, from {rmb.snap.stun.0}s up to {rmb.snap.stun.1}s the further it flew. Swollen: +{rmb.snap.swollen_k%}% damage. Rank 3: you speed up {rmb.snap.boost.cast%}% on the cast and {rmb.snap.boost.hit%}% on a hit, for {rmb.snap.boost.t}s.

e.name: Brimseed
e.desc: Drop a seed up to {e.reach}m away at the cursor (on ground, short of walls). It swells for {e.grow}s up to {e.rmax}m wide, a light column rising when it is nearly full, and waits there for you: press E again (from {e.min_recast}s) to pop it. It stays at full size until you pop it. Damage {e.dmg} up to {e.dmg_max_k} times that by how long it grew. Swollen: larger and quicker.

x.name: Nightwell
x.desc: Tap: a pale dome of the well's exact size appears at the cursor (up to {x.range}m away, on ground short of walls) and everyone sees it for {x.tell}s. Then the well opens for {x.time}s, {x.r}m wide: every foe inside, or who walks in, is stunned until it closes and drawn to its middle, taking a small hit every {x.tick}s. Allies are untouched. You are locked in the cast while the dome fills (no moving, no turning after the first {x.wind}s, nothing else); when it opens you are free to move, fight or leave while it keeps pulling (a stun or knock frees you early). Swollen: {x.r_swollen}m wide. {x.cooldown}s.

rank3.sec: a burst of speed when you cast and when it hits
rank3.dash: allies beside you when you leave, or where you land, get a shield
rank3.kin: the seed burns foes inside while it grows ({e.burn} a second)

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown {rmb.cooldown}s -> {cd3.sec}s, damage +{dmg3.sec%}%; you speed up {rmb.snap.boost.cast%}% on the cast and {rmb.snap.boost.hit%}% when it hits, for {rmb.snap.boost.t}s.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown {e.cooldown}s -> {cd3.kin}s, damage +{dmg3.kin%}%; the growing seed burns foes inside for {e.burn} a second.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge {cd.dash}s -> {cd3.dash}s; allies beside you or at your landing within {dash.ally_r}m get a {dash.ally_shield} shield for {dash.ally_shield_t}s.

tells.half: a ring of teal motes closes around him
tells.full: the lantern burns white and his ribbons lift
tells.dash_spent: a pale ripple where he stood
